connector.name: Goodeye
connector.registryDescription: Design, save, and run outcome-aligned AI workflows and verifiers, with reliable image output.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.goodeye.dev over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.goodeye, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token: an OAuth access token from Goodeye sign-in, or a good_live_ API key (Bearer good_live_...). Anonymous requests receive 401 with WWW-Authenticate so clients can discover the OAuth flow.
